_comment: Chapter 5 of the story revamp (docs/gameplay/23 §4): F25, a scene: the wooden horse Bran carved.

text.zh_TW: 桌上有一隻小木馬，耳朵被咬得坑坑巴巴的。你認得那些牙印——小時候，你一直咬著這樣一隻木馬睡覺。
text.en: On the desk stands a little wooden horse, its ears chewed ragged. You know those teeth marks. As a small child you always fell asleep chewing a horse just like it.
